name: janction-render
description: JANCTION Render: cloud GPU render farm for Blender that AI agents call as an MCP server. Send a .blend, a bpy script or a 3D file (glTF/FBX/USD) and get frames or an MP4 back. No local Blender or GPU. Free up to 500 JPY of GPU time per new key, then 0.1 JPY per GPU-second.
